work.title: Middlemarch: A Study of Provincial Life
work.author: George Eliot
work.coverage: Prelude + Book I-VIII + Chapters I-LXXXVI + Finale

scene_records.delta2_state: choice -> commitment -> altered future choice space
scene_records.mechanism: A chosen commitment changes later feasible choices rather than merely adding a local event.
scene_records.variation: The meaning of commitment depends on the pre-existing model of the future and the person chosen.
scene_records.loss_risk: High if commitment is reduced to a generic relationship event.

scene_records.event: experienced reality conflicts with projected marital model
scene_records.delta2_state: expectation gap -> model reassessment -> future interpretation
scene_records.mechanism: Mismatch between projected and experienced relationship changes interpretation and subsequent choice conditions.
scene_records.variation: The agent may update the model or resist updating it.
scene_records.loss_risk: High if represented only as marital conflict.

scene_records.delta2_state: new information -> other-model change -> relationship/behavior implications
scene_records.mechanism: Information changes the internal model of another person, which can alter later interpretation.
scene_records.variation: Information gain does not guarantee model update.
scene_records.loss_risk: High if knowledge is stored without distinguishing the model built from it.

scene_records.delta2_state: relationship state -> interpretation -> suspicion -> future constraint
scene_records.mechanism: An interpreted rather than directly observed state can become causally relevant through subsequent behavior.
scene_records.variation: The interpretation may be accurate, inaccurate, or unresolved.
scene_records.loss_risk: High if suspicion is treated as equivalent to fact.

scene_records.event: new person enters the decision field
scene_records.delta2_state: prior relational experience -> new person -> comparative model -> new relationship state
scene_records.mechanism: A new relationship is interpreted through accumulated prior relational states rather than from zero.
scene_records.variation: The same new person can produce different outcomes depending on prior state.
scene_records.loss_risk: High if reduced to a generic romance triangle.

scene_records.delta2_state: individual goal + other goal -> commitment -> resource constraint -> goal conflict
scene_records.mechanism: A relationship can bind incompatible future models to shared resources and obligations.
scene_records.variation: Conflict intensity depends on the compatibility of pre-existing goals and available resources.
scene_records.loss_risk: High if reduced to simple marital incompatibility.

scene_records.delta2_state: resource change -> relationship pressure -> agency change -> future option change
scene_records.mechanism: Material constraints propagate through relationships into future decision possibilities.
scene_records.variation: Resource pressure can increase or decrease agency depending on support and adaptation.
scene_records.loss_risk: High if economics is treated as background rather than a state variable.

scene_records.delta2_state: resource failure -> consequence -> behavioral reorientation -> capability development -> relationship viability
scene_records.mechanism: Failure changes incentives and constraints, making behavior change consequential rather than merely declarative.
scene_records.variation: Failure can produce adaptation, avoidance, or further deterioration.
scene_records.loss_risk: High if labeled simply as redemption.

scene_records.event: past information is triggered and disclosed
scene_records.delta2_state: past concealed fact -> trigger -> active risk -> disclosure -> reputation/network consequences
scene_records.mechanism: A past state can remain causally dormant until information distribution changes.
scene_records.variation: Disclosure may alter reputation, trust, network position, or only local knowledge.
scene_records.loss_risk: High if secret-reveal is stored without dormant-state and information-distribution structure.

scene_records.delta2_state: previous state change alters conditions for subsequent state change
scene_records.mechanism: Narrative history is not a list of independent events; earlier changes modify later transition conditions.
scene_records.variation: Different characters can receive different downstream effects from related events.
scene_records.loss_risk: Very high if the work is compressed into a linear plot.

global_change_patterns: choice -> commitment -> future choice space change
expectation gap -> model reassessment -> future interpretation
new information -> other model change -> relationship change -> behavior
past event -> dormant -> trigger -> active risk
resource change -> relationship pressure -> agency change -> career/future change
trajectories: Dorothea: ideal -> ideal projected onto person -> commitment -> expectation collision -> other-model refinement -> relational reassessment -> different choice basis
Lydgate: professional ideal -> commitment -> resource pressure -> relational pressure -> social dependence -> reduced agency -> altered long-term life
Rosamond: idealized future model -> person fitted into model -> reality resists model -> continued interpretive pressure -> relational consequences
Fred: dependence -> failure -> consequence -> behavioral reorientation -> capability development -> relationship viability -> stable long-term state
Bulstrode: hidden past -> dormancy -> trigger -> threat -> exposure -> reputation collapse -> network consequences

resource failure changes incentives and agency
new information changes trust or suspicion depending on interpretation
past information can remain inert or trigger social consequences

people reinterpret, resist, or change behavior

private facts can remain dormant, reactivate, and propagate socially
